The '''A-36 ''Pathfinder''-class force reconnaissance vessel''' was a [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] produced by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It was an advanced version of the [[A-24 Sleuth-class scout ship|A-24 ''Sleuth''-class scout ship]].<ref name="ETU" />
